assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The diagnosis code I25.10 is assigned
The diagnosis code I34.0 is assigned
The CPT code 93229 is Mobile cardiac telemetry
The telemetry was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes
The claim for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry (CPT 93229) was denied
The denial is based on Reason Code CO-197
The required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
Coverage for this diagnostic procedure mandates advance approval
The claim cannot be processed for payment at this time
The member retains the right to appeal this determination
